dialogues.speaker: Fassbender
dialogues.text: These Nod-Krai ingredients are fascinating. Their properties are nothing like anything from Mondstadt. I really must find a way to...

dialogues.speaker: Fassbender
dialogues.text: Oh, a customer, is it? Welcome... Please feel free to browse. I've just got a few things I need to take care of here.

dialogues.speaker: Fassbender
dialogues.text: But please be aware, I can't sell you any alcohol if you're underage! Not even here in Nod-Krai!
